title: [Synthetic] Sign-in sometimes fails in an older package
body: Invented report: our archived build was labelled GDK 250600. We do not know the GDK.Net package version, exact Windows/Core NuGet versions, release tag or source commit. We think the game uses net8.0 on Windows ARM64. Sign-in sometimes fails, but we did not save the exception, numeric HRESULT, sandbox configuration or minimal sequence. Does current main prove what was wrong in that older build? The build label is fictional; do not infer that a corresponding public package exists.
